Building and Other Construction Workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act, 1996 – Building and Other Construction Workers’ Welfare Cess Act, 1996 – Implementation of the Acts – BOCW are social legislations – They were enacted keeping in mind the Directive Principles of State Policy, particularly Art.39 which requires the State to direct its policy to secure the health and strength of workers, and Art.42 which concerns just and humane conditions of work –
